name: Herb Tonic
description: A carefully prepared tonic of healing herbs. Restores health and slightly reduces corruption.
lore: Leesha Paper's tonics are legendary. Made from nightbloom, shepherd's purse, and three parts careful intention, a single vial can close a wound that would otherwise fester. The corruption-cleansing effect is a bonus — her mentor Bruna never explained why it worked, only that it did.
